reviews.review:
this game is everything i ever dreamed an aliens game to be. the graphics are sick, levels look amazing. you have a host of guns from the movies that you can use like the famous and awesome smart gun. the aliens look awesome and the animations are great when youre mowing them down, they slip and stumble as they rush you. the story is excellent, audio engineering as well.

you can play a bunch of different classes that at first may seem that many are boring but after playing most are well balanced and fun. the game is super fun when you have some friends to play with that are decent too. there are swarm modes where you can mow down waves of aliens or you can play the campaign missions. 

if i had to complain i would wish there are more campaign missions, there are about 12 and ive played them to death leveling up different guns and classes.

Game is decent and worth a buy if you're an Alien fan. It's a bummer that the game launched in a poor state or else I would have played it much earlier. Completely playable solo, but better with co-op. Cold Iron Studios is working on their next game and fingers crossed it's a sequel built on this foundation.

I'm surprised that this game is reviewed highly, cause in term of content, it feel exactly like south park snow day.

About 6 hour of mission and then you are done unless you want to grind. And not only that but its really repetitive. Most of the mission consist of reach room x defend room. reach room y defend, activate thing, defend, reach room z defend. And that's pretty much it for the whole game. 

I guess if you like grinding then this could be for you but otherwise, for the price it seems like very few non grindy mission. 

I have to admit that the art is great and truly shine in chapter 2 and 4, and that the gun gameplay feek good. The enemy ai is also interesting since it go on wall and ceilling compared to most zombie/robot fps. But i don't think it make up for the clear lack of content the game provide

The concept isnt bad...But it get boring and repetitive... The worse thing of all is the mutiplayer! none play this anymore you will be wating for a long time for someone to join and in the end you will play solo or someone very leveled up player (usually technician) will join that he will farm the monsters solo and take all the points and leaving you wondering what was the point to play...
If you're a fan of the Aliens movie, you'll like this game.
